mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT VALUES (SEQ_REPORT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{reportReason}, #{reportDetail}, DEFAULT, DEFAULT, #{reporterMemberNo}, #{reportedMemberNo}, #{targetType}, #{targetNo})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT WHERE REPORT_STATUS = 'PENDING'

SELECT r.REPORT_NO, r.REPORT_DETAIL, reporter.MEMBER_NICKNAME REPORTER_NICKNAME, reported.MEMBER_NICKNAME REPORTED_NICKNAME, r.REPORT_REASON, TO_CHAR(REPORT_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') REPORT_DATE FROM REPORT r JOIN MEMBER reporter ON (r.REPORTER_MEMBER_NO = reporter.MEMBER_NO) JOIN MEMBER reported ON (r.REPORTED_MEMBER_NO = reported.MEMBER_NO) WHERE r.REPORT_STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.REPORT_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE REPORT SET REPORT_STATUS = #{reportStatus} WHERE REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_NICKNAME reportedNickname, CASE WHEN r.TARGET_TYPE = 'B' THEN b.BOARD_CONTENT WHEN r.TARGET_TYPE = 'C' THEN TO_CLOB(c.COMMENT_CONTENT) END targetContent FROM REPORT r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.REPORTED_MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD b ON r.TARGET_TYPE = 'B' AND r.TARGET_NO = b.BOARD_NO LEFT JOIN "COMMENT" c ON r.TARGET_TYPE = 'C' AND r.TARGET_NO = c.COMMENT_NO WHERE r.REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "REPORT" WHERE REPORTED_MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND REPORT_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PENALTY WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND PENALTY_TYPE = 'WARNING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PENALTY WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND PENALTY_TYPE = 'SUSPEND'
